units.tacticalReloadMs: integer milliseconds; null for scalar-null reloads

scope.caseDimensions: weapon × magazine × selectable grip × selectable ergonomic × available ammo
scope.gripSelection: none plus WEAPON_ATTS.grip, or grip IDs in the combined VZ.61 laser slot
scope.ammoSelection: all IDs in WEAPON_AMMO[weapon].ammo, including standard-only weapons
scope.barrelSelection: weapon barrelDef only; barrels do not affect sprint recovery or ADS move
